# @kangyishuai/dsh-session-delete

> Real session deletion for DeepSeek Harness: trash by default, a plan before you delete, an audit log, and a receipt for whatever is left behind.

[![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/@kangyishuai/dsh-session-delete?color=cb3837&logo=npm)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@kangyishuai/dsh-session-delete) [![DSH](https://img.shields.io/badge/verified%20on%20DSH-0.2.2--rc.5-4b6bfb)](#compatibility--degradation) [![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue.svg)](./LICENSE)

[中文](./README.zh-CN.md)

Unofficial plugin for [DeepSeek Harness (DSH)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness). Not affiliated with DeepSeek.

> **Status: early.** Verified on the current target DSH version with `pnpm smoke:session-delete` (33 end-to-end assertions on a throwaway DSH home) and `pnpm probe:runtime`; the desktop read-only pass was done on an earlier version. The [Compatibility](#compatibility--degradation) table records exactly what was run. `pnpm gate session-delete` runs the whole release gate in one command. Treat it as young software and keep backups of anything you cannot lose.


![Delete confirmation: one line of impact, an opt-in cascade checkbox, and a Details disclosure](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kangyishuai/dsh-plugins/main/packages/session-delete/docs/images/overview.png)

## What it does

DSH's built-in _archive_ only hides a session: the id goes into the workspace's archived set and the log files stay on disk forever. This plugin does the real deletion, with the guard rails that go with it.

- **Real deletion.** The session directory is moved out of `~/.dsh/sessions/`, and the bookkeeping that still points at it (archived set, pinned set, workspace membership, projection cache) is cleaned up — so the session doesn't come back and doesn't leave a ghost entry behind.
- **Trash by default.** The first click erases nothing: the session goes to `~/.dsh/session-trash/` and can be restored. Permanent deletion is a separate, explicit action.
- **Plan before you delete (dry-run).** The confirmation dialog is generated from a plan: on-disk size, whether the session is live, how many sub-sessions it has, and which references will be cleaned. Right before execution the plan is recomputed and compared with what you confirmed; a mismatch aborts the operation instead of deleting something you didn't see.
- **Audit log.** Every delete / restore / purge appends one JSON line to `~/.dsh/session-trash/audit.log`, readable from **Settings → Session trash**.
- **Receipt after delete.** After the move, the plugin checks the places a session can be referenced and reports anything left behind (deletion is one session at a time; the trash list supports batch restore / batch permanent delete).
- **Keyboard + workspace batch.** `⌘⌥⌫` (rebindable in Settings → General → Shortcuts) opens the same confirmation for the current session, and the workspace `…` menu gains **Delete all sessions in this workspace…**, which previews the whole group and deletes it session by session.
- **Quiet UI.** One dialog line tells you what will happen (size · sub-sessions · live), the technical detail hides under **Details**, the trash panel is a single page, and maintenance (health check, audit log, receipts) moved to its own settings section. Child-session handling remembers your last choice, stored host-side in `~/.dsh/session-trash/preferences.json`.

## Screenshots

| Delete confirmation                                                                                                                           | Workspace batch                                                                                                                            | Trash                                                                                                                        | Settings → Session trash                                                                                                                     |
| --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| ![Delete confirmation](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kangyishuai/dsh-plugins/main/packages/session-delete/docs/images/confirm-dialog.png) | ![Workspace batch](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kangyishuai/dsh-plugins/main/packages/session-delete/docs/images/workspace-batch.png) | ![Trash](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kangyishuai/dsh-plugins/main/packages/session-delete/docs/images/trash-panel.png) | ![Settings section](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kangyishuai/dsh-plugins/main/packages/session-delete/docs/images/settings-section.png) |

<sub>Screenshots are captured from a live DSH desktop session with the demo data substituted in the DOM (workspace names, session titles, UUIDs and the local user path), so no real content is published. The UI language follows DSH (Chinese here).</sub>

## Install

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add @kangyishuai/dsh-session-delete
```

To run the working tree instead of a published version, pack it first — `link:` installs do not work (the host's `@deepseek-ai/*` resolution only covers packages whose real path is inside the profile):

```bash
cd packages/session-delete
pnpm pack --pack-destination /tmp
dsh plugin --profile desktop add /tmp/kangyishuai-dsh-session-delete-*.tgz
```

Re-run `pnpm pack` + `add` after changing the code.

Restart the DSH desktop app afterwards. A fresh install adds a host half, so reloading the page is not enough.

## Usage

**Batch (in trash)**: the trash list has a sticky toolbar with select-all, batch restore and batch permanent delete. Batches run 20 entries at a time with a live `n/total` progress line and a Stop button, so a selection far larger than the host's single-request bound still completes; failures are summarised and stay selected for a retry.

**Agent tool**: models can call `session_delete`, but only in two steps — `action=plan` returns the impact summary plus a single-use token (2 minutes), and `action=delete` needs that token. It refuses to delete the calling session, and a changed session invalidates the token. Deleting from the UI never requires the tool.

**Keyboard**: the delete confirmation opens with focus on **Move to trash**, so Enter deletes and Esc cancels; when deletion is blocked, focus falls back to **Cancel**. Tab moves between the checkbox, the Details disclosure and the buttons. `⌘/Ctrl + Alt + T` opens the trash. The remembered cascade checkbox means the trigger is one key press away from a batch delete — the dialog always spells out how many child sessions come along.

**Settings → Session trash**: deletion preferences (remember cascade, reset to default), a trash overview (entries, size, path), and maintenance — health check with a bookkeeping-only clean-up, operation receipts, and the audit log.

**Refresh**: the trash panel has no refresh button. It loads on open and re-syncs every 5 seconds, when the window becomes visible again, and after every restore or permanent delete.


Everything starts from a session row in the sidebar:

1. Open the session's "…" menu and choose **删除会话…** (Delete session…).
2. The confirmation dialog shows:
   - how much disk space the session occupies;
   - whether the session is live (running turn, subagents, background jobs) — a live session is stopped first, not refused;
   - how many sub-sessions it has, with a checkbox to delete them together (off by default; each child goes to trash separately);
   - the references that will be cleaned: archived set, pinned set, workspace membership, projection cache.
3. Confirm. The session moves to the trash and disappears from the sidebar.
4. **回收站…** (Trash…) in the same menu opens the trash panel, where you can:
   - see each trashed entry (title, size, deletion time);
   - **restore** it to the sidebar;
   - **purge** it permanently;
   - read the audit log.

**Health check**: Settings → Session trash → Maintenance. It is **user-triggered** — opening the settings section no longer scans your library — and the last result is cached for the rest of the page session. The check reconciles the session store against the workspace bookkeeping and reports dangling references (archived/pinned ghosts, workspace membership, orphan session dirs, broken trash entries, unfinished operations that startup reconciliation could not settle). Cleaning removes **bookkeeping only** — session files are never touched.

## Side effects & risks

Files and directories it touches:

| Path                                     | Access                          | What happens                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| ---------------------------------------- | ------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `~/.dsh/sessions/<workspace>/<session>/` | read + move                     | Located through the host's persistence seam (`stat` / `locate`); the log filename is never hardcoded. On delete the whole session directory is moved into the trash, on restore it is moved back. Same-volume moves are a rename; across volumes it falls back to copy + verify + delete.                                      |
| `~/.dsh/storages/workspace.json`         | through host API only           | Archived / pinned sets and workspace membership change via `workspaceRegistry` methods (archive, unarchive, pin, unpin, detachSession). The file is never edited by hand.                                                                                                                                                      |
| `~/.dsh/storages/session_projcache/`     | through host API, file fallback | Projection-cache entries for the session are cleared so a deleted session can't resurface in search. Direct file access happens only in the "internal" capability tier.                                                                                                                                                        |
| `~/.dsh/session-trash/`                  | create + write                  | One entry per deleted session (with a `meta.json`), `audit.log` (JSONL, one line per operation) and `journal/` (two-phase-commit records; on the next start every unfinished record is compared against what is actually on disk and the operation is either completed or rolled back, with `recover` lines in the audit log). |

- **No network access, no telemetry.**
- **macOS window drag.** The self-drawn confirmation fallback declares `data-window-drag-exclude`, so the mask cannot drag the window when it covers the title bar.
- **Restorable by default.** Delete moves files; it does not erase them.
- **Purge is irreversible.** "Purge" (and emptying the trash) really deletes the bytes. There is no undo toast and no recovery.
- **Interrupted operations are reconciled on the next start.** Every destructive step writes a journal `intent` first; startup compares it with the disk and either finishes the bookkeeping or rolls the archive gate back. States that cannot be explained from disk are left untouched and reported for manual review — never guessed.
- **Partial results are reported, not rounded up.** If a session reached the trash but reference clean-up failed, the UI says so and the receipt is marked `partial`. A restore that brought the session back but could not restore every reference/workspace/pin is reported the same way, with per-reference results and post-restore checks in the receipt.
- **Restore is not a full undo.** The log, workspace membership and the pin come back. The pin state is captured **before** the archive step — DSH clears a pin when it archives a session — stored in the trash entry and re-applied on restore. The archive flag does not come back: the plugin unarchives as the deletion gate and does not re-archive.
- **Archiving can remove a clean git worktree (DSH 0.2.2-rc.2 and later).** Moving a session to the trash archives it. Newer DSH releases record the worktrees a session created and may run `git worktree remove` on a clean one when its owning session is archived: branches and commits stay, ignored files do not. If a checkout must survive, `git worktree lock <path>` it or turn on the worktree row's `retainOnArchive` setting before deleting the session.
- **Uninstalling the plugin does not empty the trash.** `~/.dsh/session-trash/` is your recovery path and stays until you delete it yourself.
- **Data root.** Resolved as plugin config `dataRoot` → `DSH_HOME` → `~/.dsh`. If your DSH keeps its data somewhere else, point the plugin at it. If the root doesn't look like a DSH data directory, the plugin refuses instead of guessing.
- **Alpha software operating on your data.** It has passed GUI acceptance on the version in the table below, but it is still early software: back up anything you cannot lose.

## How this differs from the built-in archive

Archive is a bookmark, not a deletion: DSH adds the session id to the workspace's archived set and everything on disk stays where it was, still taking space and still indexed. This plugin moves the files out of the session tree, drops the references that pointed at them, keeps a recoverable copy in its own trash, and logs what it did. Archive keeps working exactly as before — this plugin adds a menu item, it doesn't replace anything.

## Compatibility & degradation

The package declares no `engines.dsh` range. Instead there are three layers of defense:

| Layer                    | When it runs         | What it does                                                              | What you see                                                   |
| ------------------------ | -------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------- |
| L1 version gate          | install / activation | `engines.dsh` version range. **Not declared**, so this layer is inactive. | nothing                                                        |
| L2 startup self-check    | plugin activation    | Probes every host capability it depends on.                               | a capability grade: `api` / `internal` / `minimal` / `unknown` |
| L3 per-operation refusal | every operation      | Each operation re-checks its own prerequisites; unknown always refuses.   | structured error code + reason, no half-deleted state          |

Capability grades:

- `api` / `internal` — full operation. `internal` means some steps rely on host contracts that are not in the public docs; they run and are reported.
- `minimal` — the host has no `workspaceRegistry` (for example the headless composition). Deletion works; the archive gate, pin/workspace bookkeeping and projection-cache steps are skipped and listed in the receipt.
- `unknown` — the persistence seam itself is missing: **read-only mode**. Plan, audit and trash listing keep working; delete/restore/purge are disabled.

| Plugin | Verified on DSH                 | Notes                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| ------ | ------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| 0.5.0  | **0.2.2-rc.5** (desktop)        | No code change needed for this DSH build. Verified: 86 unit tests + `pnpm probe:runtime` 72/72 + web `pnpm smoke:session-delete` **33/33** (throwaway DSH home) + desktop read-only regression **16 PASS + 2 SKIP** — with an empty recycle bin the two list-only assertions are data-dependent SKIPs (see [runtime rc.5 §6.1](../../docs/runtime/0.2.2-rc.5.md#61-session-delete-桌面回归空回收站会假红)).                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| 0.5.0  | **0.2.2-rc.3** (desktop)        | No code change needed for this DSH build. Verified: 86 unit tests + `pnpm probe:runtime` 72/72 + web `pnpm smoke:session-delete` **33/33** (throwaway DSH home) + desktop read-only regression **18/18**.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| 0.5.0  | **0.2.2-rc.2** (desktop)        | UI rebuild: the confirmation dialog opens with focus on **Move to trash** (Enter deletes), the child-session choice is remembered, the trash panel became a single page with audit/health/receipts moved to Settings, and batch permanent deletion runs in chunks of 20. The session menu now uses the official `contextMenus` contribution with `⌘⌥⌫`, and the workspace menu gained **Delete all sessions in this workspace**. Release gate green on all four stages (verify / runtime probe 72 / web smoke 33 / desktop read-only 18), and the desktop pass was re-run against the **published 0.5.0 artifact**: 18/18. |
| 0.4.9  | **0.2.2-rc.2** (desktop)        | Trash-count badge foreground now uses a paired token: the dark theme's `state-error` is a light red (`#f25a5a`), so hardcoded white sat at 3.29:1 while `label-primary-foreground` gives 5.75:1 (still 4.5:1 in the light theme). Adds `test/client.test.js`, which asserts every theme token really exists and that the badge fill and foreground stay paired. Desktop read-only regression 14/14, unit tests 53.                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| 0.4.8  | **0.2.2-rc.2** (desktop)        | macOS window-drag fix: the self-drawn dialog fallback mask declares `data-window-drag-exclude`. Desktop read-only regression on the published build: 14/14; runtime probe 67/67.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| 0.4.7  | **0.2.2-rc.2** (throwaway home) | `pnpm smoke:session-delete`: 24/24 on a throwaway DSH home, after fixing the smoke's row selection (it had counted the unsaved “new chat” row as a session — see [runtime 0.2.2-rc.2 §7](../../docs/runtime/0.2.2-rc.2.md)). Desktop read-only regression on the installed 0.4.6 (same code except one Biome template literal): 14/14.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| 0.4.2  | **0.2.2-rc.1** (desktop)        | `pnpm smoke:session-delete`: 24 assertions green; plugin active with no bundle error on the same host version.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| 0.4.2  | 0.2.1-rc.5 (desktop)            | `pnpm smoke:session-delete`: 24 assertions green; manual GUI pass on the same host version.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |

After a DSH upgrade: restart, then open the plugin status (settings → plugins). If it reports read-only mode, the host API changed — upgrade the plugin or report the version pair; don't force it.

## Troubleshooting

| Symptom                                                    | Likely cause                                                                            | What to do                                                                                            |
| ---------------------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| No 「删除会话…」 in the session menu                       | The client half didn't load: plugin inactive, or the menu slot was renamed              | Check the plugin status, make sure the plugin is enabled, restart the app after installing            |
| The menu item is there, clicking it reports read-only mode | The L2 probe can't find a host capability it needs (a DSH update changed an API)        | Upgrade the plugin; if it stays read-only, open an issue with the status output and your DSH version  |
| Delete succeeded but the row stays in the sidebar          | The client-side removal channel changed                                                 | Refresh the page; if the row survives, open an issue with your DSH version                            |
| A restored session lost its archive flag                   | DSH clears the pin when archiving; the plugin restores the pin but not the archive flag | Expected; file an issue if the log or workspace membership itself didn't come back                    |
| Purge left something behind                                | Residue that the post-delete receipt lists                                              | Read the receipt and the audit log, clean the listed path by hand, and open an issue with the receipt |
| The trash panel is empty after a delete                    | The plugin resolved a different data root than your DSH (`DSH_HOME` / config)           | Look at `~/.dsh/session-trash/` on disk and check the plugin's `dataRoot` config                      |

# @kangyishuai/dsh-session-rewind

> In-place conversation rewind for DeepSeek Harness: send the conversation back to before any user message, withdraw everything after it from the model context and the transcript, optionally restore the workspace files those turns changed, and put the message back into the composer.

[![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/@kangyishuai/dsh-session-rewind?color=cb3837&logo=npm)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@kangyishuai/dsh-session-rewind) [![DSH](https://img.shields.io/badge/verified%20on%20DSH-0.2.2--rc.5-4b6bfb)](#compatibility) [![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue.svg)](./LICENSE)

[中文](./README.zh-CN.md)

Unofficial plugin for [DeepSeek Harness (DSH)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness). Not affiliated with DeepSeek.

> **Status: early.** End to end verified against the current target DSH version — the [Compatibility](#compatibility) table records exactly what was run (unit tests, throwaway-home GUI suite, real-desktop read-only and `--recall` suites) and when. `pnpm gate:session-rewind` runs the whole release gate in one command. Young software — keep backups of anything you cannot lose.

## What it does

Long conversations drift. A few turns later you wish you had answered a prompt differently, but starting a new session loses everything before it, and continuing keeps the unwanted turns in the context window forever. This plugin rewinds **in place**:

- **Two entries.** Press `Esc` `Esc` to open the rewind dialog, or click the ↶ button in any user message's action row (next to Copy).
- **Running turns are not a dead end.** Confirming a rewind while a turn is running cancels that turn (keeping the queue), waits for it to go idle, then re-plans against the settled history.
- **State-change warnings.** If the withdrawn range changed session state that lives outside the transcript — plan mode, goal, todo list, model selection, permission/sandbox presets, agent preset, scheduled tasks, working directory — the dialog lists it and says that rewinding does not roll that state back.
- **Two scopes, chosen per rewind.** The confirmation dialog offers **Rewind conversation only** (default) and **Rewind conversation and files**. The dialog first shows a dry-run preview: how many messages and roughly how many tokens will be withdrawn, which files will be restored or moved to the trash (including how many deleted files will be recreated), conflicts, and skipped files.
- **Conversation.** The target message and everything after it are withdrawn from the model-visible context and from the transcript. The session id, title and earlier history are untouched. Nothing is deleted from the log — one marker event is appended.
- **Files (optional).** Files changed by `write` / `edit` / `apply_patch` in the withdrawn turns are restored to their pre-change content, including files the agent deleted (they are recreated, parent directories included). Files created after the target are moved to the plugin's trash instead of deleted. A rescue point of the current files is created before anything is written; failures roll back from it. Rewinds can be repeated: each one is judged against the intended target state, so rewinding again to an earlier message is not blocked by the state an earlier rewind created.
- **Composer.** The target message's text (and images) is put back into the composer, ready to edit and send again. An existing draft is never overwritten. Tick **Send this message again right after rewinding** in the confirmation dialog to retry the turn in one click (conversation-only rewinds).
- **Prompt recall without rewinding.** In the composer, bare `↑` on an empty draft (or with the caret on the first line) recalls the last prompt you sent in this session — `↑` again walks further back, `↓` walks forward and restores the draft you had before browsing. It only replaces the draft text: nothing is withdrawn from the context, sent or rewritten. Toggle it in **Settings**.
- **Every view stays in sync.** Rewind in one tab or window and other open views of the same session hide the withdrawn rows immediately, without a reload (the notice travels through `localStorage`; the host's cuts remain the only source of truth).
- **Rewind panel.** A new header action opens a panel with three tabs: **Withdrawn** (every message each rewind removed, searchable, copy or put back in the composer), **History** (a timeline of each rewind and each rescue-point file restore, newest first: scope, message count, tokens, file results), and **Rescue points** (restore files from an earlier rescue).
- **Settings → Session rewind.** Default scope, page size, confirm-on-list, the composer recall toggle, and diagnostics (whether the read-only tool registered, plus data root and usage).

## Read-only agent tool

The plugin also registers one **read-only** tool, `session_rewind_candidates`, so the model can reason about rewinding without performing it:

| Call                                       | Result                                                                                                                                         |
| ------------------------------------------ | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `session_rewind_candidates {}`             | Newest-first list of messages this conversation can be rewound to (`query` filters, `limit` caps at 50).                                       |
| `session_rewind_candidates { target_seq }` | Impact preview for one message: how many messages would be withdrawn, whether an unfinished tool call would be truncated, and the target text. |

The tool never rewinds, never edits files and never appends to the session log — the rewind itself stays a user action (that is the point of the ADR 0006 design). Set `readOnlyTool: false` to unregister it; **Settings → Diagnostics** reports whether it registered.

## What it looks like

![The rewind confirmation dialog: target message, how many messages and tokens will be withdrawn, conversation-only vs conversation-and-files, and the resend option](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kangyishuai/dsh-plugins/main/packages/session-rewind/assets/session-rewind-confirm.png)

![The rewind panel: withdrawn messages, history timeline, rescue points and settings](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kangyishuai/dsh-plugins/main/packages/session-rewind/assets/session-rewind-panel.png)

Both screenshots come from a throwaway DSH home containing only a synthetic workspace and session (`pnpm shots:session-rewind` regenerates them), cropped to the dialog and the panel.

> Image links are absolute (`raw.githubusercontent.com`) on purpose: npm does not ship `assets/` in the tarball, so a relative path would render as a broken image on npmjs.com.

## Install

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add @kangyishuai/dsh-session-rewind
```

To run the working tree instead of a published version, pack it first — `link:` installs do not work (the host's `@deepseek-ai/*` resolution only covers packages whose real path is inside the profile):

```bash
cd packages/session-rewind
pnpm pack --pack-destination /tmp
dsh plugin --profile desktop add /tmp/kangyishuai-dsh-session-rewind-*.tgz
```

Re-run `pnpm pack` + `add` after changing the code. The plugin has a host half, so restart the DSH desktop app and refresh the page.

## Usage

**Keyboard — `Esc` `Esc`.** In an idle conversation, press Escape twice quickly. The rewind dialog lists user messages, newest first; search, page to older messages with ↑/↓, Enter or click to choose. Then the preview opens; pick a scope and confirm. While a turn is running, `Esc` `Esc` keeps its native meaning (stop the turn); press it again when idle.

**Message action — ↶.** Every user message has a ↶ button next to Copy. It opens the same preview/confirmation dialog. Nothing is rewound until you confirm.

**Commands.** `/rewind` opens the same candidate list. `/rewind @<seq> [chat|both]` executes directly (the preview's seq is shown in the list). `/rewind` is decorated by the client; the bare form never sends text to the model.

**Composer history — `↑` / `↓`.** Focus the composer and press `↑`: the newest prompt you sent in this session fills the draft; `↑` again walks further back, `↓` walks forward, and one more `↓` past the newest entry restores the draft you were typing. It works with an empty draft or when the caret sits on the first line — inside a multi-line draft on a later line the arrows keep moving the caret. Recall never rewinds, never sends and never writes to the session log. History covers the messages still in the model-visible surface (100 newest, older ones dropped) and excludes what an earlier rewind withdrew — those live in the panel's **Withdrawn** tab.

**After a rewind** the target text returns to the composer (images are re-attached best-effort) and the composer is focused. If the composer already held a draft, the draft is kept and a notice says so.

**What is refused**

| Situation                                                                     | What happens                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| The session has a running turn                                                | It is cancelled first (queued steering messages are dropped), then the rewind runs. Set `cancelRunning: false` to refuse instead (`session-rewind/busy`).                                                                                      |
| The session is a subagent child                                               | No ↶ button and no `Esc` `Esc` dialog: the Harness refuses generic session RPCs there.                                                                                                                                                         |
| The target message was shadowed by compaction                                 | Refused; the rewind boundary must still be in the model context.                                                                                                                                                                               |
| A file was changed or deleted outside the agent since the last recorded state | File mode is refused with a conflict list; no file is touched. Only files the agent itself deleted (or that an earlier rewind moved to the trash) are recreated. Content that matches a state this session recorded is not an external change. |
| A file is larger than 8 MiB, a symlink, or under `.git` / `node_modules`      | That file is skipped and reported; other files still proceed.                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| A rewind is already running on this session                                   | Refused; one at a time.                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |

## File restore scope & safety

- **Tracked changes only.** Only DSH file tools `write`, `edit` and `apply_patch` are tracked, and only under the session's working directory. Changes made by `bash`, scripts, external programs or subagents are **not** tracked; the plugin never claims a complete workspace snapshot.
- **Before every write.** The engine records the content before the tool runs, deduplicated by SHA-256 under `<DSH_HOME>/session-rewind/blobs/`. Before restoring, it compares the current state with the intended target state: files already at their pre-change content are left alone, files the agent deleted (or that an earlier rewind moved to the trash) are recreated, and anything else aborts the whole file operation with a conflict list — including a file the agent changed but something else deleted afterwards (`missing`).
- **Rescue before mutation.** All current affected files are copied to a rescue point first. If that fails, nothing is written. A failed restore rolls back applied files from the rescue point; failed rollbacks are reported. The five latest rescue points per session can be restored from the Rewind panel (a new rescue is created first).
- **Destructive operations go to trash.** Files created after the rewind target are moved to `<DSH_HOME>/session-rewind/trash/<session>/<auditId>/`, never `rm`'d. (Restoring a file that an earlier rewind moved to the trash relies on that trash record still existing; trash entries are pruned by the retention policy below, after which such a file is reported as a `missing` conflict instead.) Files larger than 8 MiB, symlinks and excluded trees are left alone and reported.
- **Write targets are canonicalized.** Restore, rescue-point restore, trash restore and rollback re-run the same path check as capture before each write: the parent directory is resolved with `realpath` and must stay inside the session working directory, and the target itself must not be a symlink. This closes the long windows (plan/preview → apply, panel restore days later). A directory swapped concurrently between the check and the write itself is outside the plugin's protection — this is defense in depth, not a sandbox.
- **No undo.** This plugin deliberately does not implement conversation undo/redo (it would require patching DSH internals). The withdrawn content stays in the session log and the Rewind panel; file-level recovery is available through rescue points and trash.
- **Order.** Preview and conflict checks run before anything is written; then the rescue point; then the conversation marker; then file writes. Once the marker is appended the conversation rewind stands even if file writes fail (they are reported and audited).

## Data & retention

All plugin data lives under `<DSH_HOME>/session-rewind/` (`DSH_HOME` defaults to `~/.dsh`):

| Path                            | Contents                                             |
| ------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------- |
| `blobs/`                        | content-addressed file contents (SHA-256)            |
| `sessions/<id>/entries.jsonl`   | per-session file change records (newest shown first) |
| `trash/<session>/<auditId>/`    | files created after a rewind target                  |
| `rescues/<session>/<rescueId>/` | rescue points (current files before a restore)       |
| `audit.jsonl`                   | one line per rewind (append-only)                    |

On startup the plugin also removes data for sessions that no longer exist (they were deleted); the audit log is kept. Cleanup only runs when the live sessions can be enumerated safely: the dry-run plan is written to the audit log first, and the plugin skips cleanup with a logged warning when enumeration finds no live session at all, when the session store does not look like `sessions/<workspace>/<session-id>/` (unknown layout — including a partial/mixed layout where a workspace has no recognizable session directory, or mixes in one that does not look like a session directory), or when any workspace is unreadable. It never treats "unknown" as "every record is an orphan", and plugin records it does not recognize are kept and logged (and counted in diagnostics). Retention: the 20 latest message anchors per session, the 5 latest rescue points, the 20 latest trash operations (30 days), and a 1 GiB soft cap across blobs/trash/rescues. When the cap is exceeded, old trash → old rescues → unreferenced blobs → oldest anchors are cleaned in that order; if still over the cap, new captures stop and diagnostics report it (no referenced data is deleted). Uninstalling keeps the data. The data root can be overridden with the plugin's `dataRoot` config.

## Side effects & risks

- **Appends one marker event per rewind** to the current session log; nothing is deleted or rewritten.
- **Writes and deletes workspace files only in file mode**, after confirmation, with the safety described above.
- **The marker is visible to the model** as a short `(empty message)` user message where the withdrawn turns used to be. It is not shown in the transcript.
- **No network, no telemetry.** Everything is local; file snapshots may contain sensitive content, so treat `<DSH_HOME>/session-rewind/` like your workspace.
- **Private client seams.** Hiding rows and injecting the ↶ button rely on DSH's internal view/slot registries. They are shape-checked at install and degrade to “context rewound, transcript not hidden” or “button missing” rather than breaking a session.
- **Recall is a draft edit.** It fills the composer through the host facade, so `Ctrl+Z` steps back through recalls like any other draft change; it never appends to the session or the model context.
- **POSIX/macOS paths only** in this version; Windows separators and permission bits are not verified.
- **macOS overlays don't drag the window.** The drawer, its mask and the confirm dialog declare `data-window-drag-exclude`, so dragging over them while they cover the title bar behaves normally (verified with a real mouse drag on DSH 0.2.2-rc.2; earlier builds could drag the whole window).

The plugin declares no `engines.dsh` and no `@deepseek-ai/*` peer range: DSH is pre-release and semver ranges over prereleases are unreliable (see [ADR 0005](../../docs/adr/0005-dsh-version-compatibility.md)). Treat the table as the compatibility statement. After a DSH upgrade run `pnpm probe:runtime`, `pnpm smoke:session-rewind`, and check the plugin's diagnostics tab; if a private seam changed, the plugin degrades instead of breaking the session.

## Development

```bash
pnpm test                     # unit tests (host engine, host RPC, client helpers)
pnpm verify                   # repo-wide gates
pnpm smoke:session-rewind           # temp DSH home + real GUI end-to-end (needs dsh & ego-browser)
pnpm smoke:session-rewind-desktop   # desktop (Electron) read-only check (24); --recall adds 7 composer-recall checks; --deep --workspace <dir> adds the file-mode run (40 total)
```

# @local/dsh-botmode

DeepSeek Harness 的 Bot 团队模式插件（Host + Web Client 双半区，v0.6.0）。

- 每个 Bot 独立目录、SOUL/MEMORY、永久私聊会话，以及**按房间隔离的隐藏 Group Session**（支持配置房间共享工程目录 `workDir`）
- 每个 Bot 可单独绑定模型：DSH 默认（空绑定，下一轮重新读取）、provider/model、思考档位；模型目录标出是否支持图片输入
- Bot 聊天可发图片（PNG/JPEG/WebP/GIF），纯文本模型由 Host 在入队前拒绝
- `message_agent` 异步队友消息（会话级 FIFO、跳数护栏 `MAX_AGENT_HOPS=4`、同链去重、回信降级、>16k 落盘、群聊隐藏会话严格禁止）
- **Hermes 底座 + 终态驱动全异步 Actor 并发群聊（Group Room）**：
  - 2–6 人，支持 `auto`（并发协作 / `@` 接力）/ `everyone`（全员并发审阅）/ `lead`（Lead 统筹派工与验收）
  - **全异步 `BotActor` 总线 + 快照水位线防漏看**：空闲 Bot 并发响应消除慢 Bot 木桶效应；提交前锁定 `snapshotSeq` + `selfSentSeqs` 跳过集，杜绝并发漏看；精准 `@` 他人消息零 Token 推进水位线
  - **3 种显式业务终态（默认无回合数硬切）**：`completed`（仅显式调用 `room_finish_task` 触发，绝不靠正文正则误判）、`settled`（全员 `(pass)` 且无在途任务/待审批）、`waiting_user`（`@user` 询问，或局部挂起等待工具审批 / `ask_user_question`，不阻塞其他并行成员）
  - **3 个病态异常探针兜底**：连续 5 轮纯文本零工具/零改文件/零认领空转软暂停（`idle_spin`）、单 Bot 连续 3 次重复报错指纹局部暂停并广播排障求助（`paused_error`）、软 Token 预算检查点（`token_budget`，点继续无损续跑）
  - **共享任务板与文件软锁 + 分轨流式渲染**：`claim_subtask(taskId, paths)` 配合 DSH 工具拦截层软锁防并发覆写文件；前端底部按 `botId` 分轨实时流式展示思考与工具状态，完成后按 `seq` 到达顺序固化入主聊天流；人类中途发言采用 **Soft Steer 软插话**（不强杀在途脚本，仅 `Stop` / `/stop` 全局强停）
- **全局可插拔团队记忆库（Memory Hub）**：
  - 所有 Bot 共用一套全局激活的记忆库插件，按 `team_id` + `agent_id (= bot.id)` + `user_id` 严格隔离各 Bot 记忆
  - 默认内置 `memory_tencentdb`（对接 v3 HTTP Gateway `127.0.0.1:8420`，支持 L0–L3 并行预取与异步写入、熔断保护，网关未启动时自动回退至 Node 22 原生 SQLite FTS5）
  - 同时内置 `local_sqlite`（纯本地零依赖 SQLite FTS5）与 `builtin`（仅 `MEMORY.md`）
  - 支持在页面或 `/botmode memory install` 一键下载、安装、配置、热切换与卸载其他记忆库插件
- Host 持久 Routines：cron 解析 + 冷会话唤醒，定时器在 `ctx.effect()` 内
- Bot 审批与提问桥：`approval/request`（once / session / always / deny）与 `user-questions/request`（`ask_user_question`）同时覆盖私聊与隐藏群聊会话

安装（桌面端）：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop install /path/to/dsh-bot/packages/dsh-botmode
```

状态根：`$DSH_HOME/botmode`。HTTP：`/botmode/api/state`、`/botmode/api/models`、`/botmode/api/memory`、`/botmode/api/image`、`/botmode/api/command`。

测试：

```bash
node packages/dsh-botmode/test/host.test.mjs
```

完整架构、命令表与限制见仓库根目录 [README.md](../../README.md)。

# dsh-botmode — DeepSeek Harness 的 Bot 团队模式

给 DeepSeek Harness（dsh）加一个 **Bot 模式**：侧边栏一个切换入口，进入一个独立的 Bot 团队页面。每个 Bot 有自己的目录、人格、记忆、模型绑定、工具白名单和永久会话；Bot 之间可以互相派活；2–6 个 Bot 能进 Group Room 并行协作直到任务完成；Host 侧持久 Routines 能在会话冷却后按 cron 唤醒 Bot。

当前版本：`0.6.0`（Host 编排 + Client 页面双半区均已落地；Hermes 底座 + 终态驱动全异步 Actor 并发群聊 + 异常探针软暂停 + 共享任务板与路径软锁 + 可插拔全局 Memory Hub 内置 `memory_tencentdb` + Bot 单独绑定模型、思考档位与视觉能力）。

## 它解决什么

Hermes 的 Bot Mode 本质是「一组有身份的 agent + 一个群聊确定性状态机 + 一个可插拔记忆库 + 一个常驻调度器」。本插件把这四件事分别落到 dsh 的真实能力上：

| 能力 | 实现 |
| --- | --- |
| Bot 身份隔离 | `$DSH_HOME/botmode/bots/<slug>-<id>/` 下的 `bot.json`、`SOUL.md`、`MEMORY.md`、`.dsh/skills/team/SKILL.md`；每个 Bot 独立 `sessionId`、模型、工具策略、审批策略 |
| 永久 Bot Chat | `botId → canonicalSessionId`，Host 通过 `sessionController` 创建/恢复；`/new`、`/reset` 在 Bot 会话里触发 `onPreCompress` 记忆检查点后做 compaction，不换会话 |
| 队友消息 | `message_agent` 工具：会话级 FIFO、跳数护栏（默认 4 跳）、同链去重、回信降级、目标歧义拒绝、`expectReply` 回送、超 16k 落盘；群聊隐藏会话严格禁止 |
| Group Room | 2–6 人；独立隐藏 Group Session + 可选共享工程目录 `workDir`；全异步 `BotActor` 并发总线 + 快照水位线防漏看；`completed`（`room_finish_task` 显式终态）/ `settled`（全员 `(pass)` 自然收敛）/ `waiting_user`（`@user` 与局部审批/提问挂起）；空转 `idle_spin`、单 Bot 重复报错 `paused_error`、软 Token 预算 `token_budget` 三大探针兜底；`claim_subtask` 任务板与文件写入软锁；前端底部按 `botId` 分轨流式渲染 + `seq` 到达序固化；Soft Steer 软插话与 `stop` 强杀 |
| 团队记忆库（Memory Hub） | 所有 Bot 共用一套可插拔记忆库插件，按 `team_id` / `agent_id (= bot.id)` / `user_id` 隔离；默认内置 `memory_tencentdb`（对接 v3 Gateway `8420` + 熔断 + 本地 SQLite FTS5 自动降级），另内置 `local_sqlite` 与 `builtin`；支持通过目录、npm、Git、tarball 或本地目录下载/安装/切换/卸载其他记忆库插件 |
| 持久 Routines | Host 自己解析五段 cron，`setInterval` 包在 `ctx.effect()` 中；支持冷会话唤醒、手动 `Run now`、暂停/恢复 |
| 审批 | Bot 私聊与隐藏群聊会话的 `approval/request`（`once / session / always / deny`）及 `ask_user_question`（`user-questions/request`）均由 Host 桥接；群聊会话局部挂起不超时误杀，私聊无人值守 2 分钟自动拒绝 |
| Sections | 分组存于 `state.json`，侧边栏按 Section 分组；Bot 表单可选 Section，可新建 Section |
| 页面入口 | `sidebar.panellist` 图标 + 侧边栏底部 `Bot 模式` 按钮；`main` 面板 key `botmode` |

## 安装

插件是标准 dsh bundle，包名 `@local/dsh-botmode`，通过 profile 的 `dsh.bundle.patch` 插入一行 Host 插件，并带一个 `dsh.client` 前端模块。

```bash
# 在 dsh 里（或桌面端插件管理器中）把本目录作为 bundle 安装
dsh plugin --profile desktop install /path/to/dsh-bot/packages/dsh-botmode
```

桌面端也可以直接用 Plugin Manager 的 `install_bundle`，target 传包目录绝对路径。安装后：

- Host 行：`include:botmode`，模块 `@local/dsh-botmode`
- Client 模块：`@local/dsh-botmode/client`
- 状态根：`$DSH_HOME/botmode`

改完代码后，用 Plugin Manager 关闭再打开 `include:botmode` 即可重载 Host；Client 改动刷新页面即可（若在跑 `pnpm run dev:web`，会热更新）。

## 使用

1. 侧边栏点机器人图标，或底部 `Bot 模式`，进入 Bot 页面。
2. `新建` 一个 Bot：名字、角色、常驻指令、分组、模型、工具白名单、审批策略。模型默认跟随 **DSH 默认模型**；也可以单独指定 provider/model、思考档位（reasoning effort）和视觉能力。表单从 Host 的实时模型目录读取：每个模型会标出可选的思考档位与是否支持图片输入，纯文本模型不能给 Bot 发图。
3. 创建后会立刻生成目录与身份文件，并创建一个 canonical Session。
4. 在 Bot 详情里直接聊天；回复按官方轨迹样式渲染：思考过程可折叠、正文 Markdown/代码块、工具调用行可展开参数与输出，流式时有 shimmer 与光标。输入框可附加 PNG/JPEG/WebP/GIF 图片（最多 6 张、每张 12 MB），前提是这个 Bot 当前绑定的模型声明了图片输入能力；纯文本模型会在发送时被 Host 拒绝。`定时例程` 区域可以建 cron、立即跑、暂停、删除。
5. 建 Group Room：选 2–6 个 Bot，选路由模式，发一条消息。`@某个Bot` 指定先手；回复里 `@别人` 接力，`@user` 会暂停并标记“需要你”。
6. 需要审批时，页面顶部出现审批条：允许一次 / 本会话允许 / 总是允许 / 拒绝。

## 目录结构

```
packages/dsh-botmode/
  index.js              Host 插件入口：服务、工具、命令、HTTP、approval 桥、Memory Hub 挂载
  client.js             Client 模块：Bot 页面、群聊界面、Memory Hub 管理页、侧边栏入口、i18n、CSS
  host/
    store.js            state.json (v4) 原子写 + 串行 mutate；Bot/Room/Memory 目录与会话映射
    persona.js          SOUL.md / MEMORY.md / TEAM.md / team skill 与记忆库静态块渲染
    dispatch.js         会话级 FIFO、隐藏 Group Session、模型/图片、Memory prefetch/syncTurn、message_agent 链式护栏
    models.js           实时模型目录、DSH 默认模型解析、思考档位与视觉能力
    room-protocol.js    纯函数群聊协议：非指令文本剥离、精准 @mention、零 Token Actor 路由过滤、报错指纹计算、增量 delta 与任务板注入
    room-locks.js       共享任务板（claim_subtask）与 DSH 文件修改工具（write/edit/apply_patch/str_replace_editor）路径软锁校验
    rooms.js            终态驱动全异步 BotActor 并发总线（快照水位线防漏看、completed/settled/waiting_user、三大异常探针、Soft Steer）
    routines.js         持久 cron 调度器（冷会话唤醒）
    cron.js             五段 cron 解析与下一次时间
    approvals.js        Bot 审批桥（覆盖私聊与隐藏群聊会话）
    api.js              /botmode/api/state + /models + /memory + /image + /command
    memory/
      protocol.js       Hermes 风格 MemoryProvider 基类、manifest 校验、无意义短语门控
      manager.js        全局单选 Memory Hub 编排器（内置+外部发现、热切换、按 agent_id 隔离）
      installer.js      记忆库下载安装器（catalog / npm / git / tarball / local 校验与卸载）
      catalog.js        预置可一键安装的记忆库模板（Mem0 / Generic HTTP）
      providers/
        memory_tencentdb/   内置 TencentDB 四层记忆库插件（v3 Gateway 8420 + 熔断 + SQLite FTS5 自动降级）
        local_sqlite/       内置纯本地 Node 22 SQLite FTS5 记忆库插件
        builtin/            内置纯 MEMORY.md 文件模式
  test/host.test.mjs    Host 逻辑全量无头测试
  cordis.patch.yml      插入 Host 行
  package.json          dsh.bundle.patch + dsh.client
```

持久状态：

```
$DSH_HOME/botmode/
  state.json                     sections / bots / rooms / routines / memory
  rooms/<roomId>.jsonl           Group Room append-only 完整事件日志
  memory-plugins/<id>/           用户下载安装的外部记忆库插件（plugin.json + index.js）
  memory-data/                   本地 SQLite FTS5 记忆数据库（fallback 与 local_sqlite）
  bots/TEAM.md                   团队名册
  bots/roster.json               机器可读名册
  bots/<slug>-<id6>/
    bot.json                     该 Bot 的完整记录
    SOUL.md                      人格与常驻指令
    MEMORY.md                    长期记忆（Bot 可自己改）
    .dsh/skills/team/SKILL.md    如何用 message_agent 与 memory 工具
```

## Host API

所有请求先过 dsh 的 Connection 同源/登录栅栏；未登录返回 401。

- `GET /botmode/api/state` → roster、sections、rooms（含 transcript/activity/watermarks/预算/运行态）、routines、approvals、memory 摘要、工具名、状态根
- `GET /botmode/api/models[?force=1]` → 实时 provider/model 目录、每个模型的思考档位与 `vision` 能力、当前 DSH 默认选择
- `GET /botmode/api/memory` → 完整 Memory Hub 状态、已安装记忆库、可下载目录与实时健康探测
- `POST /botmode/api/image`，body 为图片二进制，`content-type` 为 `image/png|jpeg|webp|gif` → `{ ok, attachment }`
- `POST /botmode/api/command`，body `{ type, ... }`

命令：

| type | 参数 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `bot.save` | `botId?`, `draft` | 新建/更新；新建会建目录、建会话、写身份文件 |
| `bot.delete` | `botId` | 删记录、停调度、删目录、重写团队文件 |
| `bot.dispatch` | `botId`, `text`, `images?` | 入队一条用户消息；`images` 是 `/botmode/api/image` 返回的附件引用数组 |
| `bot.stop` | `botId` | 取消当前 turn |
| `section.save` / `section.delete` | `sectionId?`, `name` | 分组 |
| `room.save` / `room.delete` | `roomId?`, `draft` | Group Room（含 `mode` / `leadBotId` / `workDir` / `purpose` / `notes` / `tokenLimit` / `idleRoundLimit` / 可选 `maxRounds` `maxMessages`） |
| `room.send` / `room.control` | `roomId`, `text` / `action` | 发消息（默认 Soft Steer 软插话，`/stop` 强停）/ `continue` `stop` `resume_bot` |
| `routine.save` / `routine.delete` / `routine.toggle` / `routine.run` | 见页面 | 例程 |
| `approval.decide` / `question.decide` | `approvalId` / `questionId`, `decision` / `answers` | 工具审批 `once` `session` `always` `deny` 与交互提问回答 |
| `memory.select` | `providerId` | 全局热切换所有 Bot 使用的记忆库插件 |
| `memory.configure` | `providerId?`, `teamId?`, `userId?`, `prefetchEnabled?`, `syncEnabled?`, `syncGroupRooms?`, `config?` | 更新记忆策略或插件配置并热重载 |
| `memory.test` | `providerId?` | 探测记忆库连通性与运行模式 |
| `memory.install` | `source`, `activate?`, `overwrite?` | 从目录模板 / npm / Git / tarball / 本地目录下载安装其他记忆库插件 |
| `memory.uninstall` | `providerId` | 卸载外部记忆库插件（内置受保护） |
| `memory.search` | `botId`, `query`, `limit?` | 按指定 Bot 隔离空间测试记忆检索 |

## 工具与命令

Host 注册的工具（仅 Bot 主会话或隐藏群聊会话可用）：

- `message_agent({ target, message, expectReply? })`：异步队友消息（含 4 跳防环、同链去重、目标歧义校验；群聊隐藏会话禁用）。
- `bot_team({ action: roster|me|rooms })`：名册、自己的身份（含精确 `inRoom`/`running`/`queued`）、所在 Room。
- `claim_subtask({ taskId, title?, paths?, status? })`：群聊共享任务板认领、文件路径软锁声明与完成释放（仅群聊会话可用）。
- `room_finish_task({ summary, deliverables?, verification?, force? })`：显式验收并结束群聊任务进入 `completed` 终态（仅群聊会话可用；配置 Lead 时仅 Lead 可调用）。
- `memory_search` / `memory_tencentdb_memory_search`：检索当前 Bot 的 L1 原子记忆。
- `memory_conversation_search` / `memory_tencentdb_conversation_search`：检索当前 Bot 的 L0 历史对话。
- `memory_read_scene` / `memory_tencentdb_read_scene`：列出或读取当前 Bot 的 L2 场景块。
- `memory_save`：显式持久化一条长期事实、偏好或决策到当前 Bot 的记忆空间。

人类命令：

```
/botmode status
/botmode roster
/botmode dispatch <bot> <text>
/botmode room <roomId> <text>
/botmode routine <routineId>
/botmode memory status|list|use <id>|test|install <source>|uninstall <id>
/botmode scaffold
```

## 测试

```bash
node packages/dsh-botmode/test/host.test.mjs
```

覆盖：cron 解析、store/身份文件、Dispatcher 会话隔离与 FIFO、默认模型与单独模型绑定、图片能力校验与图片消息、模型目录、Group Room 协议纯函数（引号/代码块防误触、`@all`/`@user`/`@你`、`(pass)` 归一化、顺位轮转）、Group Room 多轮状态机（隐藏群聊会话、多跳接力、提交前 Watermark 防漏看、全员 pass 收敛 `settled`、上限 `capped`、`stop` 取消与 Epoch 插话打断）、`message_agent` 跳数与去重护栏、Memory Hub（`memory_tencentdb` v3 HTTP Gateway + 离线自动本地 SQLite FTS5 降级、Bot 间隔离、`local_sqlite` 切换、目录模板与本地插件下载安装/卸载）、审批策略、API 全端点。

## 边界与已知限制

- `/new`、`/reset` 的压缩依赖当前组合里装了 compaction 引擎；压缩前会调用记忆库 `onPreCompress` 钩子。
- Bot 的模型变更在**下一次 turn**前由 Host 重新绑定；记忆库切换立即热生效于所有后续 turn 的 `prefetch` / `syncTurn` 与工具调用，静态 system prompt 块在新建/恢复会话时更新。
- 图片输入需要模型在提供方声明的 `inputModalities` 里包含 `image`。
- 审批条依赖 Bot 页面打开；无人值守时 2 分钟自动拒绝，避免 Routine 或群聊卡死。
- 所有 Bot 共用一个 Host 进程、各自独立私聊会话与按群隔离的隐藏群聊会话。
- `lib/` 编译产物未生成，当前直接发 ESM 源码；Node 内置模块 + 相对导入，避免 profile 解析第三方依赖。

evidence.readmeExcerpt:
# dsh-english-reader **在 DeepSeek Harness 里朗读英语：粘贴一段文字，逐句跟读，随时从上次停下的地方继续。** 右侧栏一个标签页，或侧栏一个整页面板。逐词高亮、逐句翻译、Edge 在线与本地 Kokoro 两种引擎，还能接你自己的 TTS API。 [中文](README.md) · [English](README.en.md)
## 为什么需要它 读英语长文时，语音合成和阅读位置是两件事：播放器在读第 12 句，你的眼睛在第 30 句，切换回来就找不着了。 这个插件把「念到哪」和「看到哪」绑在一起：句子级定位、词级高亮、进度持久化。关掉面板、重启 Harness，回来还是那一句。 他同时照顾两件事：**文章和对话**。粘贴一篇硬换行的文章不会被拆成乱句；粘贴 `Emma: Hi` / `Daniel: Hello` 这样的对话，会自动识别两个说话人并用两套音色轮流读。


## 功能 - **两种打开方式**：右侧栏标签页，或侧栏整页面板（全宽，无输入框打扰）。 - **逐句朗读 + 断点续读**：点任意一句从那里念；进度写进存储，重开即恢复。 - **逐词高亮**：Edge 引擎报告**真实词时间戳**，当前词随语音走；本地引擎按时长估算。 - **逐句翻译**：三种来源任选——DSH 已配置的模型、免密钥的 Google、免密钥的火山翻译；译文用衬线体、次级色，与原文区分。 - **文章 / 对话自动判别**：硬换行合并成句，段落按空行切分；识别到两个人名才用双音色。 - **对话库**：保存多篇文本，可重命名、置顶、删除，列表里显示「第几句 / 共几句」。 - **连读与循环**：单句循环和「连读下一句」各自独立，关掉连读就一句一停，停在原处。 - **右键查词**：只有正在朗读的那一句把单词拆成词级；悬停出现淡框，右键弹出释义。 - **中英 / 英英 / 模型词典**：中文按词性分行，英文来自 WordNet，也可以让 DSH 模型自己写（柯林斯式整句释义）。 - **单词收藏**：词卡可收藏，头部入口进入「我的单词」，点一行在原地展开词条、例句和收藏时的原句。 - **阅读宽度与字号**：窄 / 中 / 宽 / 自定义，字号小 / 中 / 大 + 自定义 px；阅读页、对话库、我的单词三处共用。 设置卡片分四块，可折叠，只默认展开「引擎」，你展开过的会记住；一次只展开需要的部分，卡片不会撑出屏幕。 ## 安装 **方式一：从 GitHub 安装（推荐）** 在 DSH 的 **插件 → 添加插件** 里填： ``` github:KNtnx/dsh-english-reader ``` 或命令行： ```bash dsh plugin --profile web add github:KNtnx/dsh-english-reader ``` **方式二：本地目录** ```bash git clone https://github.com/KNtnx/dsh-english-reader.git dsh plugin --profile web add link:./dsh-english-reader ``` 把 `web` 换成你实际的 profile（Desktop 版通常是 `desktop`）。安装完重启 `dsh web`。 > 装好插件后 Edge 语音即可用。要用本地模型：在本地模型卡片或「添加来源」里点「下载并使用」；第一次会先说明将执行什么，确认后插件自己安装本地引擎（约 120 MB，只装一次），装好再下载约 89 MB 的模型。取消不会安装任何东西。 > > 本地引擎 `kokoro-js` 是**可选 peer**，默认不随插件安装，所以插件安装本身只有几 MB，也不会去跑那个在 CUDA 13 上必然失败的 CUDA 探测脚本。安装失败（离线、受限网络等）时面板会显示原因，也可以按「排错」手动执行命令。 ## 语音来源 内置 Edge，其余来源由你添加（侧栏面板 → 添加来源）。每个来源可以命名、编辑设置、单独删除。 | 来源 | 需要 | 说明 | | --- | --- | --- | | 微软 Edge（在线） | 什么都不用 | 神经音色，需要联网，文本发送到微软。首选的「逐词高亮」体验来自它。 | | 本地模型（Kokoro-82M） | 约 120 MB 引擎 + 89 MB 模型 | 点「下载并使用」后由插件安装引擎并下载模型；也可指向你已有的模型目录（含 `config.json` 与 `onnx/`）。只用 Edge 的用户不用安装。 | | 自定义 TTS API | 地址、协议、模型、密钥 | 三种协议：OpenAI 兼容 `/audio/speech`、阿里云百炼原生接口、Azure 语音（SSML）。只填域名即可，路径会自动探测并记住。 | **为什么协议是必选项**：同一家服务的不同接口路径和请求体完全不同。阿里云百炼的 OpenAI 兼容前缀只支持对话与向量，语音合成走原生的 `api/v1/services/audio/tts/SpeechSynthesizer`，返回的还是音频下载地址。协议决定发什么请求。 **密钥不出宿主**：面板只能读到 `hasKey: true`，读不到明文。语音来源存在 `sources.json`，柯林斯密钥存在 `dictionary.json`（都在 `$DSH_HOME/dsh-english-reader/`，权限 `0600`）；测试连接、拉列表、查词典都由宿主代取密钥。 ## 词典 三个独立选项，互不影响： **显示**：中英 / 英英 / 中文 —— 决定卡片里露出哪几种释义 **中文来源**：iciba（免费）/ 使用模型 **英英来源**：WordNet（免费）/ Wiktionary（免费）/ 柯林斯（需密钥）/ 使用模型 选「使用模型」时，**对应的供应商与模型就在它下面展开**，两种语言可以指定不同的模型。只查询正在显示的语言，所以「英英」模式不会多花一次中文查询。 | 来源 | 语言 | 需要 | 说明 | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | iciba | 中文 | 无 | 按词性分行，词组同样可查 | | WordNet（Datamuse） | 英文 | 无 | 完整句子释义，词性标记清晰 | | Wiktionary | 英文 | 无 | WordNet 之外的备份 | | 柯林斯 | 英文 | **自己的 API key** | 官方接口；密钥存在宿主机 `$DSH_HOME/dsh-english-reader/dictionary.json`（权限 `0600`），浏览器只能读到「已保存」 | | 使用模型 | 中英 | DSH 模型 | 柯林斯式整句释义 + IPA + 中文 + 例句 | 模型写出的释义是完整句子（例如 `To regulate an activity means to control it by means of official rules.`），而不是同义词堆砌。**每个词的模型释义只生成一次**，结果按 `单词|来源|模型` 缓存，切换显示语言、来源或模型都不会重复消耗额度；两个来源都没有词条时（多为生僻词组），才回落到翻译来源。 查词只对**当前朗读句**开放：其余句子是纯文本，长文的渲染开销不随句数增长。 ## 我的单词 - 点一行**就地展开**：中文按词性分行，英文释义带例句，末尾附收藏时的原句。 - 展开的内容**跟随当前词典**：换来源或换显示语言，展开区立刻重新解析，不会停留在收藏时的旧释义。 - 收藏只记录**单词和原句**，释义来自词典或缓存——所以同一个词在「英英」下看是 WordNet，在「中文」下看是 iciba。 - 三个喇叭：单词、词条例句、原句各一个；从字典卡片搜来的词没有原句，那个喇叭是灰的。 - 「我的单词」和「对话库」都可一键返回当前对话；两页共用阅读页的宽度与字号设置。 - **跨会话共享**：对话库、朗读位置和收藏的单词存在宿主（`library.json`）里，不是某个浏览器的本地存储——所以每个对话、每个浏览器打开都是同一份。

## 模型工具（`english_reader`） 对话里的模型可以直接读写这份库，不需要你打开面板：查有哪些词和文章、按夹子筛选、加词、改标题、删词、换词典，都走同一个工具。 - **按名字归类**：`folder` 收夹名（如 `25.12.1`），没有就顺手建出来；`folderId` 收 `list_folders` 给的 id，给错会报错并列出已有的夹子。 - **批量**：`add_words` / `move_words` / `remove_words` 一次处理一批词，十个词是一次调用，不是十次。 - **一次只改一件事**：读（`list_words`、`list_folders`、`list_dialogues`、`get_settings`、`define_word`）与写（`add_*`、`move_*`、`rename_dialogue`、`delete_dialogue`、`set_dictionary`、`normalize_words`）分开，写之前先列一次就知道 id。 - **归类不会被覆盖**：夹子归属由「谁最后一次移动」的时间戳决定，浏览器、另一个面板、工具三方写同一份文件也不会互相抹掉。 - **改完立刻生效**：面板每两秒问一次宿主的版本号（隐藏时暂停），工具刚写进去的词会自己出现在列表里，不用刷新页面。 ## 翻译来源 | 来源 | 需要 | 说明 | | --- | --- | --- | | DSH 自带模型 | 选择供应商与模型 | 用你在 Harness 里已经配置好的模型，译文质量最好 | | Google | 无 | 免密钥的 `translate.googleapis.com` | | 火山翻译 | 无 | 免密钥的网页接口，中文语感更自然 | 译文跟着**来源**走：每条译文都记着是哪个来源、哪个模型生成的，换来源（或换模型）会立刻重新翻译并替换屏幕上的译文，不会继续显示旧来源的版本。 ## 隐私 - 文本只在你选择的引擎上合成：本地模型完全离线，Edge 与自定义 API 会把句子发给对应服务商。 - 查词时只有你查的那个单词会发给词典来源（iciba / Wiktionary），不会上传整篇文本。 - API 密钥只存宿主，不以任何形式下发到浏览器，也不写进前端存储。 - 本机模型、来源配置与对话库分别在 `$DSH_HOME/dsh-english-reader/models/`、`sources.json` 与 `library.json`，不上传。 - 翻译与语音请求只从宿主发起，面板不直连第三方。 ## 排错 | 现象 | 处理 | | --- | --- | | 面板一片空白 | 打开浏览器控制台看报错；多半是插件客户端没加载，重启 `dsh web` | | 「本地引擎未安装」 | 点本地模型卡片里的「安装引擎并下载」，确认后由插件安装；失败时看下面「本地引擎与构建脚本」的手动命令 | | 本地模型一直「未下载」 | 点「下载」等进度到 100%；模型在 `$DSH_HOME/dsh-english-reader/models/` | | 自定义 API 报 400 / 401 | 先在编辑窗口点「测试连接」，它会显示具体路径与原始响应；401 表示密钥被服务商拒绝 | | 音色填了却不生效 | 换一个能连通的来源再试；部分服务商对未知音色是静默回退而不是报错 | | 逐词高亮不动 | 只有 Edge 引擎报告词时间戳，其余来源按字符长度估算 | | 查词一直「没查到」 | 词典需要联网；先在设置里确认字典档位，词组查不到是正常的，会走翻译来源 | | 收藏的单词原文显示「无」 | 从字典卡片搜索收藏的词没有来源句，这是预期行为 | ### 本地引擎与构建脚本 本地引擎 `kokoro-js` 是可选 peer，默认不随插件安装。点「下载并使用」时，面板会先说明将执行： ```bash pnpm add --ignore-scripts kokoro-js@^1.2.1 ``` 确认后由插件在后台执行（约 120 MB，只装一次），完成后自动继续下载约 89 MB 的模型。`--ignore-scripts` 跳过 `onnxruntime-node` 的安装脚本——它只负责下载 CUDA 加速库，CPU 推理需要的二进制本来就在包里。 安装失败时，面板会显示原因；可以打开终端在 profile 目录手动执行同一条命令后重启 `dsh web`。`link:` 安装的插件会改用插件目录里的 `npm install --ignore-scripts --no-save`。 引擎装好后，普通 `pnpm install` 仍可能因 `onnxruntime-node`、`sharp`、`protobufjs` 的构建脚本未表态而以 `ERR_PNPM_IGNORED_BUILDS` 停下（是「待批准」，不是崩溃）。插件安装成功后会尽力把 `onnxruntime-node`、`sharp` 写成 `false`；如果上游升级版本后它们又变成待批准，不要批准 `onnxruntime-node`——这个脚本在 CUDA 13 上必然失败，pnpm 随即把包丢掉： ```yaml allowBuilds: msedge-tts@2.1.1: true protobufjs@7.6.6: true onnxruntime-node@1.21.0: false sharp@0.34.5: false ``` ## 开发 **要改代码先读 [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md)**：那是一份目录，按「我要改什么 → 读哪篇」指向 `docs/modules/` 下的八个大模块与 46 篇小模块文档。改之前读那篇的「不变量」，改完回写它。 ```bash npm install # 一次：react、react-dom、jsdom 是开发依赖 npm test # 全部测试，约一秒 node --check index.js client.js worker.mjs dsh plugin --profile web add link:$(pwd) ``` 测试会在 jsdom 里挂载真正的面板并点击真正的控件——之前漏掉的问题，几乎都是两个操作同时写同一份状态。覆盖了什么、故意没覆盖什么（排版、音频、真实网络），以及遇到 bug 时怎么写测试，见 [测试流程（含浏览器复核）](docs/TESTING.zh.md) 与 [docs/TESTING.md](docs/TESTING.md)。 ``` package.json 插件清单（dsh.bundle.patch + dsh.client） cordis.patch.yml 宿主行插入 index.js 宿主：路由、来源存储、四种翻译、两族 TTS 协议 worker.mjs 子进程：Edge 与 Kokoro 引擎，词边界解析 client.js 浏览器：阅读面板、设置卡片、添加来源对话框、词高亮 locale/ 插件市场展示文案 docs/DETAIL.md 插件详情页（英文） docs/DETAIL.zh.md 插件详情页（中文） ``` ## License 除特别说明外，本仓库以 [MIT](LICENSE) 授权。

evidence.readmeExcerpt:
# Antigravity ACP for DSH **在 DSH 里使用 Antigravity 模型，工具仍交给 DSH。** 把 Antigravity ACP、Google AI Studio 和 Vertex AI 接入同一个 DSH 模型选择器，还可按需启用 Google Colab 工具。 [![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-bundle-antigravity-host?color=3b82f6&label=npm)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-bundle-antigravity-host) [![license](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-64748b)](LICENSE) [![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-%E2%89%A522.19-64748b)](#兼容性与验证范围) [快速开始](#快速开始) · [选择接入方式](#选择接入方式) · [功能预览](#功能预览) · [配置参考](docs/configuration.md) · [更新记录](docs/changelog.md)
--- > **0.1.55 · 核心依赖与切换修复**：核心模块改由 DSH Core `0.2.2-rc.5` 同一发布线提供，修复模式、凭据和项目切换后的旧请求与旧目录，并完善 Colab 的产物与取消处理。[完整更新记录](docs/changelog.md#0155--2026-11-28) ## 快速开始 ```console dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-bundle-antigravity-host ``` `web` 是示例 Profile，请替换为实际目标。**DSH NEXT Desktop 使用目标桌面壳提供的 DSH Desktop CLI**；不要用独立 npm 公共 CLI 管理保留的 `desktop` Profile。[安装与更新说明](docs/reference.md#安装与更新) 1. **安装并启用**：按部署方式重载或重启，让 Host 与 Client 一起生效；只刷新页面不保证 Host 已升级。 2. **打开「设置 → Antigravity ACP」**：需要代理时先配置并保存，再点击 **连接 / 登录 ACP**。插件优先复用已有 ACP 登录态，或导入本机已登录的官方 CLI 登录态（含 agy ≥1.5.17 在 macOS 钥匙串中的登录态，只读取出）；必要时才进入官方浏览器授权。成功建会话后读取模型目录，不需要先发送聊天。 3. **选择模型，开始对话**：提供商名称为 **Antigravity (ACP)**，路由 ID 为 `antigravity-acp`。模型选择器左侧出现紧凑额度药丸；预热入口位于设置页，工具调用继续走 DSH 的校验、审批与执行。 使用代理模式时，启用插件页的 `antigravity-proxy-router` 组件，在设置页「运行模式」勾选并保存，再点击「连接代理账户 → 打开 Google 授权页」。**无需安装 agy CLI**，在运行 DSH 的同一台电脑上授权，账户和已有项目检测通过后自动读取模型，选择 **Antigravity（代理模式）** 的模型开始对话。组件未就绪时页面说明原因，ACP 仍保持停用；代理模式不会自动预热或启动官方进程。 **额度或 AI Credits 没有显示？** 额度查询默认不调用本机 `agy`。ACP 套餐额度走内置直连，代理模式走代理账户；AI Credits 默认不查询。只有在设置页「额度」打开「用 agy CLI 查询额度」并保存后，才会调用 `agy -p /usage` 与 `agy -p /credits`。ACP 登录成功不代表 CLI 也已登录。[登录态与数据来源](docs/reference.md#登录态与额度来源) ## 选择接入方式 | 接入 | 从哪里开启 | 使用的账号或凭据 | |---|---|---| | **Antigravity ACP（默认）** | 设置 → 连接 / 登录 ACP | Antigravity 官方登录态 | | **Antigravity 代理** | 设置 → 运行模式 | 独立连接的 Google 代理账户；开启后停用 ACP | | **Google AI Studio** | 设置 → AI Studio | Gemini API key；此 Host 的用量和限流单独显示，项目总量见 AI Studio 看板 | | **Vertex AI** | 设置 → Vertex AI | 项目、区域可继承宿主环境变量；用 ADC 拉取 Gemini 模型，支持文本流式和工具回填 | | **Google Colab** | 插件 → Google Colab | [官方 Colab CLI 与已有 ADC](docs/colab.md)；可查 Compute Units，经审批在指定的现有运行时执行 Python / Notebook | AI Studio 和 Vertex AI 可与 ACP 或代理模式并用。Colab 随同一个包安装，默认关闭，不注册模型；关闭它只会移除 Colab 工具。 ## 功能预览 左：模型选择器旁的额度药丸，展开后按额度组显示窗口与剩余百分比。右：设置页的连接状态、分阶段耗时与模型管理。画面来自当前 `src/client.js` 的真实组件，数字与套餐名均为虚构。 ## 功能亮点 ### 多个对话，不再共用一个待审批回合 默认按需启动最多 **2 个独立 worker**，可配置为 1–4 个。一个会话等待工具审批时，其它会话可使用空闲 worker；同一工具回合的结果仍回到原 worker。容量用满后排队，支持取消，默认等待上限 120 秒，主对话优先于排队中的后台标题。 并发 worker 共用当前链路的上游账户额度。[并发与续轮配置](docs/reference.md#并发与工具续轮) ### 先连接、拿目录，再开始聊天 设置页区分 **立即预热** 与 **连接 / 登录 ACP**：前者准备连接但不创建会话，后者验证会话并读取模型目录，两者都不发送聊天 prompt。目录使用缓存即时显示，支持主动刷新；模型列表按模型逐项控制是否出现在 DSH 选择器、默认思考档位、显示名与官方 ID 映射。 模型家族与思考强度分开：选择家族，再由 DSH 的思考强度菜单路由到官方对应档位。不硬编码账号应当拥有的模型清单。[模型与请求项映射](docs/reference.md#模型目录与请求项) ### 图片传给模型，不只传一段文字说明 在 **宿主附件服务可用且上游声明 image capability** 时，当前消息、历史消息和工具返回的图片通过真实图片内容传入。支持 PNG、JPEG、WebP 与 GIF；只读取宿主附件，不自行抓取图片 URL。已被宿主卸载的图片会明确说明未发送像素。 图片生成走独立的 `agy_image_generate` 工具，在代理模式的「高级 → 附属功能」中启用。音频、视频未接入。[图片输入](docs/reference.md#图片输入) ### 规划与执行分开 选择 `antigravity-orchestrator` 后，插件先让 planner 产出一份带步骤与交回条件的计划，再由 executor 执行；executor 遇到工具失败、同一工具连续失败两次或用户改向时停下重新规划。两个角色均可配置：planner 三选一（Neon / Argon / Opus 5.5），executor 两选一（Hydrogen / Sonnet 5.5，默认 Hydrogen，对齐官方 Antigravity 编排设置），各带思考档位。代理模式是两次独立上游请求，ACP 模式在独立 planner 会话里跑官方 `mode=plan` 再回 chat 会话切模型执行。每回合规划次数有上限，planner 失败或超时降级为单模型执行，计划只在需要时注入。[编排模式](docs/configuration.md) · [实现规格](docs/orchestrator-design.md) ### 额度、余额与连接状态，就在对话旁 - **额度药丸**：随当前模型切换对应额度组；展开查看各组的窗口、剩余百分比、重置时间与缓存状态。额度窗口短周期在上；上游额度池合并为 Gemini 与 Claude/GPT 两组，旧的独立 Argon 组并入 Gemini 展示。 - **AI Credits**：与套餐额度独立展示、独立缓存与报错；未知不是零，不会自动开启 Credits 付费回退。默认不查询，打开「用 agy CLI 查询额度」后来自官方 CLI 账户。 - **预热与诊断**：ACP 预热位于设置页；设置页集中连接、模型、完整配置与按需展开的诊断，代理登录显示准备、授权和完成阶段。 - **手动拉取额度**：设置页点击拉取，按当前模式取数并与对话药丸共享刷新结果；打开页面不自动查询。药丸采用 subusage 风格迷你条与简短状态。 - **常驻保存与草稿保护**：保存栏滚动时留在顶部，集中显示未保存计数、撤销与冲突；后台刷新保留输入，遵守只读状态。网络修改先保存再连接。 ## 它如何工作 ```mermaid flowchart LR D[DSH 对话] --> A[本插件 LlmAdapter / worker 池] A -->|stdio · ACP v1| G[官方 Antigravity agent] G -->|私有 loopback MCP| B[本插件工具桥] B -->|挂起调用| T[DSH 校验 / 审批 / 执行] T -->|工具结果回填原 prompt| B B --> G ``` 本包是 **Host + Web Client bundle**：Host 注册模型 provider、管理官方进程和工具桥，Client 提供设置页与额度药丸。`agy` CLI 用于 ACP 只读模型目录，以及显式开启「用 agy CLI 查询额度」后的额度与余额查询。Colab 官方 CLI 由同包的可选工具组件调用，不参与模型路由。 **它不是直接的 Gemini 模型 API。** 默认情况下同一 DSH 对话会复用同一个 ACP 会话，在输入前缀与上一步输出一致时，后续回合只发送新增消息，未变化的上下文去重，变化内容仍发送，历史由官方 agent 自己持有；历史被压缩、回退或编辑，或模型、系统提示、工具目录变化时自动重建会话并全量重放一次（`reuseSessions=false` 可回到每轮重放）。工具续轮仍在同一个 prompt 内完成。角色消息、采样控制、延迟与计费不能视为和原生 API 相同。 ## 使用前，先知道这些边界 | 边界 | 当前行为 | |---|---| | 工具与权限 | AGY 内置工具、ACP fs / terminal 关闭；只允许已识别的私有桥请求进入 DSH，`allow_once` 不等于绕过 DSH 审批。协议约束**不是 OS 沙箱**。 | | 登录材料 | 插件可能读取 CLI 登录文件与 macOS 钥匙串条目（均只读），并为官方 ACP 写入 / 更新本机凭据文件；这些文件不是加密凭据库，Windows 访问保护依赖目录 ACL。 | | 官方程序 | 按需从 `https://dl.google.com` 下载，拒绝重定向并检查 ZIP 路径；官方未提供校验和，不宣称签名验证通过。默认 server 版本为 **1.5.2**，不跟随 registry 自动升级。 | | 模型参数 | `reasoningEffort` 映射官方档位；`maxTokens` 忽略；显式 `temperature` / `stop` 记录警告并忽略，值不生效。 | | 数据可信度 | 缓存、失败、缺字段和未知分别标记；额度与余额是上游快照数据，不是计费数据。 | | 版本与测试 | 宽 peer 范围是安装条件，不是全部 Core / 平台版本实机兼容证明；隔离测试不替代真实账号与 GUI 验收。 | ## 兼容性与验证范围 | 项目 | 当前声明 / 证据 | |---|---| | Node.js | `>=22.19` | | 当前源码的 DSH Core peer 范围 | `>=0.2.2-rc.5 <0.2.3-0`；运行期使用宿主的 LLM、子进程、Typert、附件和凭据模块 | | Cordis peer 范围 | `~4.1.0` | | 开发契约基准 | DSH Core **0.2.2-rc.5**、Cordis **4.1.0** | | 上游协议 | ACP **v1**；SDK **1.4.0** 与默认 server **1.5.2** 是两个独立版本 | | 0.1.54 本地验证 | 类型检查、68 个测试文件（1129 项通过、1 项跳过）和构建。 | | 桌面组件验证 | DSH NEXT **2.0.24-next** / Core **0.2.2-rc.5**：隔离验证了模型路由并存、Typert 注册与清理、Colab 工具注册和停用，以及无审批渠道时拒绝执行。 | | 待实机验收 | 完整 Desktop GUI、真实 Vertex AI 生成、Colab 账号余额和 Notebook 执行。已有 AI Studio 上游验证见[技术记录](docs/aistudio-provider-design.md#11-真实-key-探针核实结论2026-11-27)。 | 插件复用宿主的核心模块，不私装固定的旧版本。附件和凭据**服务**仍按功能使用：没有附件服务时可文本聊天，没有凭据服务时 AI Studio 无法读取 API key。[完整声明与验证方法](docs/development.md) ## # @local/books — 书架插件 for DeepSeek Harness

一个在 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-Harness) 内**阅读和管理本地书库**的插件。侧边栏提供独立的「书架」面板，支持 TXT / EPUB / PDF / AZW3 / DOC / DOCX（以及 MOBI / AZW）。

## 功能

- 📚 **书架面板**：侧边栏新增书本图标，独立中央面板显示书库。
- 📖 **多格式阅读**：TXT / EPUB / PDF / AZW3 / DOC / DOCX / MOBI / AZW。
  - TXT 自动识别 BOM / UTF-8 / GB18030 编码。
  - EPUB / AZW3 按 spine / 章节顺序抽取正文。
  - DOCX 用 python-docx 抽取（标题/作者/章节/表格）；DOC 优先用本机 Microsoft Word COM 抽取，无 Word 时用 olefile 回退。
  - 有文字层的 PDF 逐页抽取文本。
  - **扫描版 PDF**（无文字层）自动切换为逐页看图模式：翻页、缩放、←/→ 键翻页。
- 📄 **整页翻页**：文字书按窗口高度切成一屏一页，←/→ 键或按钮整屏翻动；章节下拉跳转、"全文"渐进加载（不卡顿）。
- 🏷️ **分类**：自定义分类（手动勾选） + 📁 文件夹分类（按书库目录结构自动生成）。
- 🔤 **公文排版**：默认按《党政机关公文格式》(GB/T 9704-2012) 排版——正文三号仿宋、每面 22 行、每行 28 字、行距 1.75 倍、首行缩进 2 字、两端对齐。可切换 5 种预设（公文 / 舒适 / 紧凑 / 大字 / 自动），也可自定义行数、每行字数、行距、字体。字号按可用屏幕自动反推并夹在 13–28px 之间；窗口过小时自动缩减行数而不是把字缩到看不清。偏好保存到配置文件。
- 🗑️ **删除书籍**：每本书有两个删除选项——「仅从书架移除」（保留本地文件，可随时重新导入恢复）或「从书架移除并删除本地文件」（永久删除，不可撤销）。
- ⚙️ **自定义书库位置**：通过原生目录选择窗口指定路径，可一键把已有书籍搬到新位置（跨磁盘自动复制后删除），也可恢复默认位置。
- 📈 **阅读进度**：每本书自动保存阅读位置（章节/页码），书架卡片显示进度百分比；再次打开时自动续读。
- 🎨 **配色主题**：阅读界面可切换跟随系统 / 纸白 / 护眼米黄 / 夜间 / 深灰五种配色（不影响书架）。
- 🔍 **书内搜索**：在当前书籍的全部章节中全文搜索关键词，点击结果跳转到对应章节（扫描版 PDF 无文字层，不支持搜索）。
- 🅰️ **每本书独立排版**：排版可设为「全局」或「仅此书」，为不同书保存各自的排版偏好。
- 🤖 **Agent 工具**：模型可通过 `books` 工具 `list` / `read` / `add` / `setpath` / `delete` 访问同一书库。
- 🏛️ **在线图书馆**：侧边栏切换到「在线图书馆」，可检索并在线逐页阅读开放数字资源。**纯在线浏览，不下载到本地、与本地书架完全分离，版权归原权利方所有。**
  - 🇨🇳 **国家图书馆·公版民国文献**（约 319 种）：输入关键词检索或浏览书目，进入后逐页查看扫描图 + OCR 文字，支持 ←/→ 翻页。
  - 🇨🇳 **广东省立中山图书馆·广东通志开放索引**（25 个卷目标）：开放 OCR 全文（繁简对照），纯文本逐页阅读；个别纯图页（图表）标注「此处为图表」。
  - 🇨🇳 **陕西省图书馆·历史文献数据库**（104 部古籍/方志，含国家名录 48 + 省名录 56）：逐卷展平为连续页码，原图逐页浏览（←/→ 翻页、缩放）；平台暂未开放 OCR 文本，为纯图片阅读。
  - 🇨🇳 **江苏省古籍数字资源集成平台**（南京图书馆等，全库 2.6 万余条书目 / 327 万页影像）：全库目录 + 标题检索，逐卷探测页数并展平为连续页码，原图逐页浏览；平台未开放 OCR 文本，为纯图片阅读。
  - 🇨🇳 **湖南省图书馆·古籍智慧化平台**（346 部古籍）：目录 + 检索，逐页原图 + OCR 文本对照阅读（平台 AES 加密与签名已匿名破解，全文可读）。
  - 🇨🇳 **广东省立中山图书馆·报图览粤**（清末民初广东画报，28 类图片故事约 1689 则）：按分类浏览，逐则查看高清原图，图片直链无登录。
  - 🌐 **多馆切换**：在线图书馆顶部显示「图书馆源」切换条，来自 [dsh-library-sources](https://github.com/KunWu1980/dsh-library-sources) 周度索引（国家图书馆 / 广东 / 陕西 / 江苏 / 湖南 / 报图览粤等）。当前 6 个适配器已就绪（绿色「可阅读」），其余标注「待接入」。索引随仓库更新，新适配器上线后插件无需改代码即可显示新馆。索引读取优先级：远程 → 本地缓存 → 插件内置基线，离线也能正常显示；插件内置的本地适配器会覆盖过期索引，保证已支持馆始终可读。

## 安装

本插件是一个 DeepSeek Harness **bundle 插件**。在 Harness 中安装：

1. 克隆 / 下载本仓库到本地。
2. 在 Harness 里用插件管理器安装该目录（bundle 入口由 `package.json` 的 `dsh.bundle.patch` 指向 `cordis.patch.yml`）。
   - 或在对话中让 Harness 执行：`plugin_manager install_bundle`，target 指向本目录。
3. 首次加载后如提示需要重启，重启 Harness。

## 依赖

Host 侧调用本机 Python 解析书籍，需要以下 Python 包（装入 Harness 的捆绑 Python 或系统 Python 均可）：

```
pip install pypdf ebooklib mobi beautifulsoup4 lxml pymupdf python-docx olefile pywin32
```

其中 `python-docx` 用于 DOCX；DOC 优先用本机 Microsoft Word（通过 `pywin32` 的 COM）抽取，未安装 Word/非 Windows 时退回到 `olefile`（纯文本提取，排版可能不完美）。`pywin32` 仅 Windows 需要。

Python 可执行文件的查找顺序：插件配置 `python` → 环境变量 `BOOKS_PYTHON` → Harness 捆绑 Python（`~/.dsh/dsh-runtimes/.../python.exe`）→ `PATH` 中的 `python`。

DRM 加密的书籍不支持。

## 隐私

插件不上传任何数据；所有书籍、配置、缓存都只保存在本机：

- 配置：`~/.dsh/books-plugin/config.json`
- 文本提取缓存：`~/.dsh/books-plugin/extract-cache/`
- 页面图片缓存：`~/.dsh/books-plugin/page-cache/`

默认的书库位置是用户主目录下的 `Books` 文件夹，可在设置面板中随时更改。

「仅从书架移除」会把书号记入 `config.json` 的 `hiddenBooks` 列表（文件仍在磁盘上）；重新导入同一文件即可让它重新出现。「删除本地文件」则会真正 `unlink` 磁盘上的文件并清理空目录。

## 许可

插件自身代码采用 MIT 许可（见 [LICENSE](LICENSE)）。其 Python 依赖（pypdf / ebooklib / mobi / PyMuPDF / python-docx / olefile / pywin32 等）各有独立许可，使用前请自行查阅；部分依赖为 copyleft 许可，本地个人使用通常无碍。

No candidate code or lifecycle hooks were executed; runtime safety and compatibility are unproven.

evidence.readmeExcerpt:
Oh My Claude

English | 中文

Claude Code, native inside dsh

Drive your logged-in Claude Code CLI as a first-class dsh provider: no API key, no extra services, no runtime dependencies.

Built with AI assistance, and open to more. Contributions from AI coding agents are welcome; start with CONTRIBUTING.md.

--- Claude Code CLI as an LLM provider for [dsh](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/dsh). Every request drives `claude -p` with stream-json in and out, so it uses whatever login, hooks, CLAUDE.md files, MCP servers and rate limits Claude Code already has. No API key needed. The plugin speaks the CLI's own protocol (the one the Agent SDK wraps) directly, so it has no runtime dependencies. ## Tour

The shield is dsh's own control. In a Claude session its rows become Claude's six permission modes, each labelled with the dsh access level it sets underneath.

One `✻` button beside the composer opens the whole plugin: Memory, Instructions, Skills, Rewind, Changes, MCP, Asides, Diagnostics, Tasks and Tune, plus a Restore tab while the session is still blank.

Cost and cached token count, two figures dsh cannot compute, join dsh's footer stats row. The pill turns orange once a session passes the spend line you set. The dollar figures are what the turns would cost at API rates; on a Claude subscription you are not billed them.

Plan usage and the CLI's own context breakdown live in dsh's context ring popover. On a phone the panel becomes a sheet.

Once an SSH box is saved, dsh's own Add workspace dialog gains a box dropdown: a folder on that box becomes a workspace here, and the session in it runs Claude Code there. Shots by tools/playwright/tour.ts. ## Install You need the Claude Code CLI on `PATH` and logged in (`claude --version` works, `claude` opens without asking you to sign in), and dsh 0.2 (0.2.2-alpha.2 or newer). On dsh 0.2.0 or 0.2.1, install 1.5.14 (`dsh-oh-my-claude@dsh-0.2.1`); on dsh 0.1.x, install the npm tag for your line from the Compatibility table below. Nothing else: no API key, no Node build step. **From dsh's Plugins page**, in the web app or DSH Desktop: 1. Open **Plugins** in the sidebar and press **Add plugin**. 2. Enter `dsh-oh-my-claude` and press **Install**. 3. Press **Enable now**, or turn on its switch later under **Installed plugins**. It loads without a restart. Reload the page and "Oh My Claude" appears in the model picker with the models your login can use. Pick one and chat. **From a terminal**, then restart dsh however you run it: ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-oh-my-claude systemctl --user restart dsh-web.service ``` To install straight from the repository instead of npm, use `github:lcestou/dsh-oh-my-claude` as the package name in either route. The plugin speaks English and Chinese and follows dsh's own language setting (Settings → General → Language), switching as soon as you change it. If the picker lists it as `Oh My Claude (not logged in)`, run `claude auth login` in a terminal on the box that runs dsh, or press Log in under Settings → Oh My Claude → Boxes. **DSH Desktop** (macOS and Windows) uses the Plugins page steps above. The plugin looks for `claude` in the usual install folders, since an app started from the Dock does not see your shell's PATH. On Windows it runs Claude as a plain child of dsh, so restarting the app ends a running turn, and the parts that need a Unix shell (Log in from Settings, SSH boxes) are not available. The server half has run under Electron on Linux the way Desktop runs it, and on Windows 11 with Claude Code installed from npm. When a newer version is on npm, an orange pill with the version number appears in Settings and on the panel's Runtime line. A click opens Oh My Claude on dsh's Plugins page, where dsh's own Update button installs it; the copy button beside the pill puts the update command on the clipboard for a terminal. DSH Desktop gets the pill too, without the copy button, since its CLI has no command to copy. Details, and the repairs the plugin makes on its own after a dsh upgrade, are under [Plugin updates](https://github.com/lcestou/dsh-oh-my-claude/blob/main/docs/how-it-works.md#plugin-updates). Optional, in `~/.dsh/settings.yaml`: ```yaml agent-default-model: # make Claude Code the default for new sessions provider: claude-code model: claude-fable-5-1 # any model id the picker lists subagent-model-selection: # let dsh subagents run on Claude Code too enabled: true allowedModels: - provider: claude-code model: claude-haiku-5-5 # any model id the picker lists ``` Working on the plugin itself? Start at [docs/developing.md](https://github.com/lcestou/dsh-oh-my-claude/blob/main/docs/developing.md). ## Compatibility dsh ships prereleases only and moves client APIs between them, so every release of the plugin records the dsh line it was written for and the dsh it was driven on.
